safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not state haemodynamic stability; instead notes no vitals/physical exam performed.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute chest-pain presentation, documenting haemodynamic stability helps convey urgency and guides triage/management decisions (e.g., whether the patient appears critically unwell). Its omission can lead to uncertainty or miscommunication about acuity, although an ambulance was already being arranged in the encounter.
